name: IT / AIOps Agents
description: Incident, change, and SLO vocabulary + starter questions.
starter_prompts: Which services had incidents this week and what was MTTR?
List changes deployed in the last 7 days and any related incidents
Which alerts are noisy (firing > 5x/day with no action)?

terminology.description: Unplanned service interruption/degradation. Severity P1-P4 drives response.
Mean Time To Restore — core reliability KPI.
A planned modification to a service. Unapproved changes are the top self-inflicted outage cause.
Service Level Objective — internal reliability target (e.g. 99.9% availability).
Alerts that repeatedly fire without requiring action — agents propose tuning, humans approve.
Documented remediation steps. Agents execute runbooks only within defined guardrails.
